design_defect: P0 and P1 received only field names and selected enums in the natural-language prompt, whereas P2 and P3 additionally received the complete machine-readable JSON Schema through provider enforcement. The planned P2-minus-P1 contrast therefore combined output-contract information completeness with constrained decoding and could not identify the L1 enforcement increment.
decision: Stop the whole schedule, retain all outputs as an excluded design-audit batch, and do not resume or selectively reuse any unit. A successor must put the same complete authoritative JSON Schema in every arm's prompt and vary only provider enforcement between P1 and P2.
